mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO user_view_history (user_id, content_id, view_time, position_ms, reported_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{viewTime}, #{positionMs}, #{version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_time = GREATEST(view_time, #{viewTime}),
position_ms = CASE WHEN reported_at IS NULL OR #{version} > reported_at THEN #{positionMs} ELSE position_ms END, reported_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(reported_at, #{version}), #{version})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_view_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_view_history h INNER JOIN content c ON h.content_id = c.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId}
